title: Venesection
summary: VENESEC'TION, noun [Latin vena, vein, and sectio, a cutting.] The act or operation of opening a vein for letting blood; blood-letting; phlebotomy.

inlines.v: VENESEC'TION, noun [Latin vena, vein, and sectio, a cutting.] The act or operation of opening a vein for letting blood; blood-letting; phlebotomy.
